## Downloads

| File | Use it when |
|---|---|
| `FxDeck-<version>-win-x64.exe` | **Recommended.** Self-contained: nothing to install, just run it. |
| `FxDeck-<version>-win-x64-slim.exe` | Much smaller, but requires the .NET 10 **Desktop Runtime** and the **ASP.NET Core Runtime** (both x64) to be installed: https://dotnet.microsoft.com/download/dotnet/10.0 |

`SHA256SUMS.txt` lists the checksums of both files.

The executable is not code-signed, so Windows SmartScreen may warn once ("More info" → "Run anyway"). See the [README](https://github.com/Acc-Off/FxDeck#readme) for setup instructions.
